_meta.notes: The Extruderlijst 3A is a BLANK hourly shift-log form: it defines WHAT the operator measures each hour but contains no pre-printed numeric setpoints (those parameters have value=null here). All numeric targets/ranges come from Cedo-PROD-FORM-008 (Checklist line 3, rev 01, issue 14-1-2022) and cover the 3A extruder train plus the shared line-3 front end. 3B-only rows live in shift_checklists.json. Never treat null values as zero.
